record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.context_brief: Classical spaces with unknown numerical index
record.original_question: Compute the numerical index of the following Banach spaces: C^m[0,1] with any of its usual norms, Lip(K) for a complete metric space K, Lorentz spaces, and Orlicz spaces.

evidence.quote: Problem 6. Compute the numerical index of C m[0, 1] ..., Lip(K) ..., Lorentz spaces, and Orlicz spaces.

artifact.status_search_result: The numerical indices of these classical spaces (C^m[0,1], Lip(K), Lorentz, and Orlicz spaces) remain listed as open problems in surveys and lecture notes on the numerical index of Banach spaces. Recent works (2021–2024) have studied the related Lipschitz numerical index and the numerical index of Lipschitz-free spaces, but no general formula for n(Lip(K)), n(C^m[0,1]), or for Lorentz/Orlicz spaces has been established.

status_evidence.title: Numerical range of operators, numerical index of Banach spaces (lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Computing the numerical index of C^m[0,1], Lip(K), Lorentz spaces, and Orlicz spaces is listed among the open problems.
status_evidence.claim: These computations are still listed as open problems in surveys on the numerical index.

status_evidence.title: On the Lipschitz numerical index of Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of the Lipschitz numerical index and renorming results; the linear numerical index of Lip(K) is not determined in general.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work investigates related Lipschitz numerical indices but does not solve the original problem.

status_evidence.title: The numerical index of 2-dimensional Lipschitz-free spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Computes the numerical index of Lipschitz-free spaces over 2-point or related small metric spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results are available, for very restricted metric spaces.
